ops.old: Butter-basted chicken breasts with a creamy mushroom and thyme sauce, crunchy roast potatoes and steamed broccolini, a proper dinner dance plate. Parboil 1kg potatoes for 8 minutes, toss in oil and roast at 220C for 45 minutes. Season 4 chicken breasts and brown in oil 4 minutes a side, add 30g butter and thyme and baste, then finish at 200C for 10 minutes. Rest. In the same pan cook 250g sliced mushrooms and 1 shallot, add 125ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer until thick. Steam 2 bunches broccolini.
